svg.title: P05: Asynchronous-generator loop
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Primitive / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Expose incremental execution events.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: A consumer observes an agent run incrementally.
The runtime emits a semantic event or streamed token.
Async yield/resume, cancellation, and cleanup ownership.
Consumers receive ordered events and early exit releases runtime resources.
The producer exposes an async iterator or equivalent streaming boundary.
Each emitted event has a stable type and sequence context.
Cancellation and producer failure do not leave unreleased work.
Abandoned consumers trigger cancellation or documented cleanup.
1 Consumer → EventStream open()
2 EventStream → Producer start()
3 Producer → EventStream yield(event)
4 EventStream → Consumer emit(event)
5 Consumer ↩ CancellationToken cancel()
6 CancellationToken ↩ Producer cancel()
7 Producer ↩ CleanupHandler release(next)
8 CleanupHandler ↩ Consumer closed()
Stream event schema, backpressure, buffering, and consumer adapters.
Test event order, consumer cancellation, producer exception, and cleanup.
A synchronous list returned at the end is not the streaming pointcut.
